description: This file defines the DataGroup entity class which maps to the 'ohrm_data_group' database table using Doctrine ORM annotations. It includes properties such as id, name, description, permissions flags, and relationships to other entities like DataGroupPermission and ApiPermission. The class provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Entity class for representing a data group with permissions and metadata. Maps to 'ohrm_data_group' table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the data group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the data group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the data group.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the data group.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the data group.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether the data group has read permission.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether the data group has create permission.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether the data group has update permission.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether the data group has delete permission.
